The <b>Beastling Call</b> is an [[Skills and Abilities (Silksong)#Needolin Melodies|ability]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It allows [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to return to the [[Bell Beast]]'s current location.

== Function ==
Hornet can play the Beastling Call to summon the Bell Beast's [[Beastlings]]. After playing for a second or two (enough to drain one strand of [[Silk]]), the Beastlings dig out of the ground around Hornet and take her back to the last Bellway station she arrived at, where the Bell Beast is.

As the Beastlings have to tunnel through the ground to reach Hornet, and Hornet needs to jump to enter the hole they dig, they cannot appear in certain scenarios, including:
* Floating platforms
* Thin platforms such as metal gratings and trapdoors
* Corridors with low ceilings
* Certain rooms and areas flagged as inaccessible:
** [[The Abyss (Silksong)|The Abyss]]
** [[Border Caves]] and the surface
** [[First Sinner]]'s cage
** Hanging bellhomes in [[Bellhart]]
** The [[Diving Bell|diving bell]]
** The room with a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] and a [[Map and Quill (Silksong)|map]] station in the [[Cogwork Core]]
** Greyroot's hut 
** The room where Hornet awakens after becoming [[cursed]]
{{MissingInfo}}

If Hornet attempts to play the Beastling Call but fails, she looks around as a Beastling's cry echoes in the distance. The failure animation triggers before any Silk can be deducted.

Using the Beastling Call cures Hornet of a [[Muckmaggot]] infestation.

== How to Acquire ==
The Beastling Call can be acquired during Act 3 after defeating [[Bell Eater]] in any Bellway.

== Trivia == 
* When Hornet plays the Beastling Call, she holds her Needolin at a higher angle than usual.
* The melody of the Beastling Call is a version of the Bell Beast's theme.
* In the [[Blasted Steps]] and [[Sands of Karak]], using the Beastling Call near [[Sandcarver]] pits may cause Hornet to dive into the Sandcarvers and continuously take damage. This will result in Hornet's death unless the game is quit.
